description: Official Texas retail electricity statistics: EIA monthly average price (¢/kWh), sales, customers and revenue by sector; BLS CPI electricity and all items; BLS average price per kWh. Monthly series: the free window is the latest month. Free (no key or free key): the most recent 30 days of each series; a Pro key unlocks full history. Values are exact as published with unit, date and original source URL; incomplete days are flagged, never filled. Free for non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use requires Pro.

measure.description: price, sales, customers, revenue (comma-separated; default all)

sector.description: eia861m: res, com, ind, tot (or all); eia_retail: res, com, ind, tra, oth, all. Default res.

series.description: Optional exact series ids from market_catalog (comma-separated)

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days ending at the series' latest date. Older dates need a Pro key.

name: market_texas_retail
